prompt: One continuous intimate cinematic shot, eight seconds, 16:9. The same original fictional Chinese woman from the approved first frame rehearses a job interview alone at her home desk, speaking towards an imagined interviewer just beside the camera. Preserve her exact face, chin-length black bob, charcoal cardigan, ivory T-shirt, graphite laptop foreground left, graph-paper notebook, black mechanical pencil in her right hand, burgundy mug, green banker lamp on camera right and cool rainy window on camera left. Eye-level 50mm medium close-up; locked camera, no zoom or orbit. At first she tries to give a polished answer. She says in natural conversational Mandarin: 因为……大家都这么做。 She hears how empty that sounds, stops, briefly looks down at the pencil, gently sets it on the notebook with one anatomically correct right hand, gives a tiny self-conscious half-smile and a soft exhale. Then she lifts her eyes back to the same off-camera point and quietly says: 不对，重来。 Leave a real pause and a settled ending; do not keep the face or hands moving continuously. Warm practical lamp against muted cool window light, natural tactile skin, restrained film grain, subtle halation, rich shadow detail. The humor is recognition, not clowning. Synchronized subtle pencil contact and room tone; no music, no narrator, no subtitles, no logos, no invented software interface, no cut, no rubbery hand or changing objects. This is a fictional rehearsal, not a testimonial or evidence of hiring success.
